Model preference: open/quantized model variants ok (Llama 2-style), but willing to test hosted LLMs if streaming + cost good. Wants ability to pin model versions for rollout.
Security: Okta SSO for internal tools, audit logging for API usage, retention controls for user messages (30/90 day options). No on-prem need today.
PoC ask: simple in-app chat proof of concept using Redwood Hosted API + streaming; measure end-to-end perceived latency for full-stack path (client -> Redwood -> model -> client).

Competitor eval: testing OpenAI for baseline but concerned about token costs; exploring Redwood for cost/perf and model choice.
Next: engineering demo (20–30m) and provide sample SDK snippet and estimated cost for 50k tokens/month and for 500k tokens/month.
